info.name: Service 5 - Security Audit Logging (Elie Medawar)
info.description:
Security Audit Logging Service, port 5005. Developed by: Elie Medawar.

Requires the Users service (port 5001) and users created by the Users collection (admin, rami, lara, nadia). Set the *_password variables locally first.
